# T4-Bench: full benchmark data

Source: https://t4b.sdad.pro/benchmarks.html
Hardware: Kaggle 2x Tesla T4 15 GB, 31 GB RAM, 4 vCPU, CUDA 13.
Source notes: https://blog.sdad.pro/
The figures come from saved runs on the same machine.

## Chat and coding models
| Model | Reply tok/s | Prompt tok/s | VRAM GB | GPUs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LiquidAI LFM2.5-8B-A1B | 119.0 | 800.0 | 5.7 | 1x T4 |
| XHToken Spark-X2.5-1.7B | 100.0 | n/a | 1.3 | 1x T4 |
| Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B | 71.0 | 165.0 | 22.0 | 2x T4 split |
| XHToken Spark-X2.5-4B | 54.0 | 1385.0 | 3.7 | 1x T4 |
| google Gemma 4 12B IT | 21.0 | 144.0 | 8.1 | 1x T4 |
| Qwen3.8-27B | 13.0 | 52.0 | 17.7 | 2x T4 split |

## Two-agent concurrency
| Agents | Per agent | Aggregate |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | 71 tok/s | 11 tok/s (load-dominated wall) |
| 2.0 | 56 + 52 tok/s | 92 tok/s over 2.3s wall |

## Tool-use evaluation
| Metric | Score |
|---|---|
| Passed / partial / failed | 9 / 4 / 2 |
| Points | 22/30 |
| Quality | 73/100 |
| Responsiveness | 74/100 (median turn 1.5s) |
| Deployability | 73/100 |
| Weakest category | Multi-Step Chains (33%) |
| Safety | 1 warning (TC-08: batched tools before reading results) |

## Spark agent tasks
| Task | 1.7B | 4B |
|---|---|---|
| T1 implement `median()` to pass 5 pytest tests | PASS, 5 steps, 1 tool error, ran tests | PASS, 4 steps, 0 errors, ran tests |
| T2 debug repo (binary-search off-by-one across 2 files), 7 tests | PASS, 3 steps, 5 errors, ran tests | PASS, 14 steps, 9 errors, never ran the suite itself (final state correct at step limit, verification gap) |
| T3 implement LRU cache from spec from scratch, 5 tests | FAIL, 3 tool steps + 17 no-call turns, never wrote a working file | PASS, 5 steps, 1 error, ran tests |
| Agentic score | 2/3 | 3/3 |

|---|---|---|
| PQ2_0 | 293.9 | 15.1 |
| PTQ1_0 | 200.3 | 15.4 |

## Ternary 27B, two T4s
| Packing | Prompt tok/s | Reply tok/s |
|---|---|---|
| PQ2_0 | 313.0 | 22.9 |

## Fine-tuning
| Method | Result | Peak GB | Loss |
|---|---|---|---|
| unsloth_native | completed | 6.9 | 0.829 |
| soup backend: unsloth | completed | 6.9 | 0.8044 |
| soup backend: transformers (unsloth installed) | completed | 14.5 | 0.8058 |
| soup backend: transformers (unsloth blocked) | OOM | 14.5 | n/a |
